question.prompt: Four siblings ordered an extra large pizza. Alex ate \(\frac15,\) Beth \(\frac13,\) and Cyril \(\frac14\) of the pizza. Dan got the leftovers. What is the sequence of the siblings in decreasing order of the part of the pizza they consumed?

solutions.explanation:
Using a common denominator makes both the leftover calculation and the comparison straightforward. Alex ate \(12/60\), Beth ate \(20/60\), and Cyril ate \(15/60\). Dan's share was
\[
1-\frac15-\frac13-\frac14
=\frac{60-12-20-15}{60}
=\frac{13}{60}.
\]
All four shares now have the same denominator. Since \(20>15>13>12\), the decreasing order is \(\boxed{\text{Beth, Cyril, Dan, Alex}}\), choice C.
solutions.title: Express every share in sixtieths
